person.name: Person
person.description: A person in baseball history — player, manager, coach, umpire, or official scorer.

team.name: Team
team.description: A baseball franchise across its history.

ballpark.name: Ballpark
ballpark.description: A venue where MLB or affiliated games have been played.

state_or_region.name: State or region
state_or_region.description: A state, province, prefecture, or other sub-national region.

game.name: Game
game.description: A single baseball game between two teams that was actually played.

season.name: Season
season.description: A single league-season (one entity per league per year).

roster_entry.name: Roster entry
roster_entry.description: A player's affiliation with a team for a single season, plus all season-aggregate stats.

staff_stint.name: Staff stint
staff_stint.description: A manager / coach / umpire / official scorer affiliation for a single season.

batting_line.name: Batting line
batting_line.description: One player's batting performance in one game.

pitching_line.name: Pitching line
pitching_line.description: One pitcher's performance in one game.

fielding_line.name: Fielding line
fielding_line.description: One player's defensive appearance at one position in one game.

play.name: Play
play.description: A single plate appearance / play-by-play event with full game state at the moment of the event.

ejection.name: Ejection
ejection.description: An ejection of a player, manager, coach, trainer, or other party by an umpire.

scheduled_game.name: Scheduled game
scheduled_game.description: A scheduled (not necessarily played) game, including future seasons and postponement / makeup metadata.

notable_game_collection.name: Notable game collection
notable_game_collection.description: A curated set of notable games (no-hitters, cycles, triple plays, etc.).

team_game_record.name: Team game record
team_game_record.description: Relation entity for Game → Team. Per-team data for a single game (side, score, manager, starting pitcher, box totals).

umpire_assignment.name: Umpire assignment
umpire_assignment.description: Relation entity for Game → Person umpire. Carries the umpire's position for that game.

roster_position_assignment.name: Roster position assignment
roster_position_assignment.description: Relation entity for Roster entry → Position. Carries games played at that position for the season.

team_ballpark_tenancy.name: Team ballpark tenancy
team_ballpark_tenancy.description: Relation entity for Team → Ballpark. Carries the date range a team played home games at that park.

handedness.name: Handedness
handedness.description: Batting or throwing hand: Left, Right, Both/Switch, Unknown.

person_role.name: Person role
person_role.description: A role a person can hold in baseball: Player, Manager, Coach, Umpire, Official scorer.

game_type.name: Game type
game_type.description: The competitive context of a game (regular, postseason, exhibition, etc.).

sky_condition.name: Sky condition
sky_condition.description: Sky / lighting conditions during the game.

wind_direction.name: Wind direction
wind_direction.description: Direction the wind is blowing during the game.

stat_type.name: Stat type
stat_type.description: Distinguishes the kind of stat-line record (Value, Official, Lower bound, Upper bound).

game_result.name: Game result
game_result.description: The outcome of a game from a team's perspective: Win, Loss, Tie.

side.name: Side
side.description: Whether a team is playing at home or visiting in a given game.

umpire_position.name: Umpire position
umpire_position.description: The position an umpire works during a game.

half_inning.name: Half inning
half_inning.description: Top or Bottom of an inning.

play_event_type.name: Play event type
play_event_type.description: An atomic outcome that can occur on a single play.

hit_trajectory.name: Hit trajectory
hit_trajectory.description: The trajectory of a batted ball (fly / ground / line / pop / bunt variants).

ejection_role.name: Ejection role
ejection_role.description: Role of the ejected party (Player, Manager, Coach, Trainer, Non-uniformed).

notable_collection_category.name: Notable collection category
notable_collection_category.description: Category for a curated game collection (No-hitters, Triple plays, etc.).

pbp_source.name: PBP source
pbp_source.description: How a play-by-play record was sourced — recorded directly or deduced.

description.name: Description
description.description: Short description used in previews and summaries.

also_known_as.name: Also known as
also_known_as.description: Alternate names (birth name, AKA, nicknames). Multi-valued.

birth_date.name: Birth date
birth_date.description: The date of birth for a person.

birth_place.name: Birth place
birth_place.description: Most-specific known birth location: City, State or region, or Country.

death_date.name: Death date
death_date.description: The date of death (null if alive).

death_place.name: Death place
death_place.description: Most-specific known death location: City, State or region, or Country.

hall_of_fame.name: Hall of fame
hall_of_fame.description: True if inducted into the Baseball Hall of Fame.

city.name: City
city.description: City the team is based in.

leagues.name: Leagues
leagues.description: Leagues this franchise has played in.

last_active_year.name: Last active year
last_active_year.description: Last active season (null if currently active).

home_ballparks.name: Home ballparks
home_ballparks.description: All venues used as home, with tenancy windows on the relation entity.

alternate_retrosheet_ids.name: Alternate Retrosheet IDs
alternate_retrosheet_ids.description: Other Retrosheet team codes used in different seasons.

opening_date.name: Opening date
opening_date.description: First game date at this venue.

closing_date.name: Closing date
closing_date.description: Last game date (null if still active).

primary_league.name: Primary league
primary_league.description: Primary league played at this venue.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Free-text notes about usage, gaps, shared tenants.

location.name: Location
location.description: WGS84 geographic coordinates (renderable: Geo location). Optional — populated via geocoding.

game_number.name: Game number
game_number.description: 0 for single game; 1 or 2 for doubleheader.

teams.name: Teams
teams.description: Teams playing in this game (Home + Away). Per-team data lives on the relation entity.

venue.name: Venue
venue.description: Ballpark where this game was played.

day_game.name: Day game
day_game.description: True = day game, false = night game.

used_dh.name: Used DH
used_dh.description: True if the designated hitter rule was used.

season.name: Season
season.description: The league-season this game belongs to.

temperature_f.name: Temperature (F)
temperature_f.description: Temperature in Fahrenheit at game time.

wind_direction.name: Wind direction
wind_direction.description: Direction of wind at game time.

wind_speed_mph.name: Wind speed (mph)
wind_speed_mph.description: Wind speed in mph at game time.

umpires.name: Umpires
umpires.description: Umpires for the game, ordered home plate first then 1B/2B/3B/LF/RF.

save_pitcher.name: Save pitcher
save_pitcher.description: Pitcher credited with the save (null if no save).

completion_info.name: Completion info
completion_info.description: Info if game was completed on a different date.

score.name: Score
score.description: Final runs scored by this team.

umpire_position.name: Umpire position
umpire_position.description: Position the umpire worked (HP, 1B, 2B, 3B, LF, RF).

games_played.name: Games played
games_played.description: Games played (total on Roster entry; per-position on Roster position assignment).

first_game_date.name: First game date
first_game_date.description: First home game date at this venue.

last_game_date.name: Last game date
last_game_date.description: Last home game date at this venue.

person.name: Person
person.description: The person this affiliation is for.

positions_played.name: Positions played
positions_played.description: Positions played, ordered: primary first then by descending games.

first_game_of_season_date.name: First game of season (date)
first_game_of_season_date.description: Person's first game with this team this season.

last_game_of_season_date.name: Last game of season (date)
last_game_of_season_date.description: Person's last game with this team this season.

role.name: Role
role.description: Role: Manager / Coach / Umpire / Official scorer.

opponent_team.name: Opponent team
opponent_team.description: Opposing team in this game (one-hop convenience).

stat_type.name: Stat type
stat_type.description: Value / Official / Lower bound / Upper bound.

game.name: Game
game.description: The game this record belongs to.

innings_pitched_outs.name: Innings pitched (outs)
innings_pitched_outs.description: Innings pitched expressed as outs (raw — 27 = 9 IP).

innings_pitched.name: Innings pitched
innings_pitched.description: Innings pitched in base-3 baseball notation (6.2 = 6⅔ IP, NOT 6.2).

loss.name: Loss
loss.description: True if this pitcher took the loss.

no_outs_recorded.name: No outs recorded
no_outs_recorded.description: True if pitcher recorded zero outs.

defensive_sequence.name: Defensive sequence
defensive_sequence.description: 1 = started at this position; 2+ = entered later.

started_at_position.name: Started at position
started_at_position.description: Started the game at this defensive position.

half_inning.name: Half inning
half_inning.description: Top or Bottom of the inning.

plate_appearance_number.name: Plate appearance number
plate_appearance_number.description: Sequential plate appearance number in the game.

score_visiting.name: Score (visiting)
score_visiting.description: Visiting team score AT this play (mid-game, not final).

score_home.name: Score (home)
score_home.description: Home team score AT this play (mid-game, not final).

batter_handedness.name: Batter handedness
batter_handedness.description: Batter's handedness at this plate appearance.

pitcher_handedness.name: Pitcher handedness
pitcher_handedness.description: Pitcher's handedness at this plate appearance.

event_code.name: Event code
event_code.description: Raw Retrosheet event code for round-trip fidelity (e.g., "S7/L", "63", "8/F").

fielders_involved.name: Fielders involved
fielders_involved.description: Fielder positions that touched the ball, in sequence.

is_plate_appearance.name: Is plate appearance
is_plate_appearance.description: True if this play counts as a plate appearance.

is_at_bat.name: Is at bat
is_at_bat.description: True if this play counts as an at-bat.

ball_in_play.name: Ball in play
ball_in_play.description: True if the ball was put in play.

pitcher_responsible_for_runner_on_first.name: Pitcher responsible for runner on first
pitcher_responsible_for_runner_on_first.description: Pitcher of record for the runner on 1B after the play.

pbp_source.name: PBP source
pbp_source.description: Whether the play-by-play was Recorded or Deduced.

home_team_game_number_in_season.name: Home team game number (in season)
home_team_game_number_in_season.description: Home team's sequential game number for the season.

away_team_game_number_in_season.name: Away team game number (in season)
away_team_game_number_in_season.description: Away team's sequential game number for the season.

postponement_info.name: Postponement info
postponement_info.description: Reason or replacement-venue info if postponed.

makeup_date.name: Makeup date
makeup_date.description: Date the game was made up (if postponed).

made_up_at_venue.name: Made up at venue
made_up_at_venue.description: Venue the makeup was played at (if relocated).

code.name: Code
code.description: Short code for a reference instance (e.g., Retrosheet abbreviation).
